dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: Something's not quite right recently... Looks like we need to get a couple more mercenaries.

dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: Nothing serious, but something's not right either way.

dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: We have a ship in our caravan, right? I recently found out that Snezhnayan imports to the Akademiya have increased by quite a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: Many caravans were surprised by this turn of events, and many agreed upon plans were disrupted.

dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: Also, I feel that the pirates have been making bigger moves these days. There have also been sightings of Kairagi in the open sea!

dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: I don't want to run into any pirate attacks. We've got to think of something.

dialogues.speaker: Abbanes
dialogues.text: Bye. I'll have to think about hiring someone.
